 if isinstance(x,torch.Tensor): yield x
 elif isinstance(x,dict):

 elif isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):

assert counts["actor"] == counts["target_actor"] == 192741+27

members += [(root/name,"control/"+name) for name in controls]

manifest=[{"source":str(p),"member":name,"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":digest(p)} for p,name in members]
archive=root/"AUGMENTED_RAW.tar.gz"
archive_existed=archive.exists()
if not archive_existed:
 with tarfile.open(archive,"w:gz") as tar:
  for p,name in members: tar.add(p,arcname=name,recursive=False)
with tarfile.open(archive,"r:gz") as tar:
 assert set(tar.getnames()) == {m["member"] for m in manifest}
